Tools that natively read AGENTS.md and .agents/skills (Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Gemini CLI via .gemini/settings.json, Cursor) need no generated copies. Verified paths and sources: harness/README.md.

instruction_targets.extra:
## Claude Code specifics

- Claude Code reads `CLAUDE.md`, not `AGENTS.md`, so this file imports it. Skills are mirrored into `.claude/skills/` from `.agents/skills/`; invoke them as `/import-run`, `/audit-run`, etc.
- `.claude/settings.json` holds permissions and a PreToolUse hook (`harness/hooks/protect_paths.py`) that blocks edits to immutable and generated paths.
